title: Compost Bin
description: Automatic composting for your farming needs
body:
This mod adds Compost Bins, which are like the Composter, but with storage and automated composting.

## Crafting

![A Compost Bin can be crafted with 8 Wooden Slabs in an outlined square pattern, similar to the Composter.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f776c1a497caf1d92ede59c388746f8aa7c63e1a.png)

## Technical details

- The Compost Bin emits Redstone output
- Items can be inserted and extracted using Hoppers
- Items are composted/filled every 8 ticks matching Hopper speed. Composting takes place in one cycle (8 ticks), slightly faster than a filled Composter.
